rules.original_latency_gate: original benchmark thresholds and exit code are preserved; exit 1 is not a cargo/pytest failure
rules.long_run_gate: complete actual-send minutes >=10 for soak or >=5 for control; complete run; both ack/visible signed OLS slope <=20us/min and last/first p50 <=1.15
rules.baseline_nonregression: strict descriptive no-increase comparison for each reported p50/p99/p99.9/max of ack/visible against the e1-archived critical-section 20000-sample cells; tolerance 0, no smoothing or best-round selection
rules.nonregression_scope: endpoint and quantile checks remain separate; throughput and >10ms frequency comparisons are informational, not invented replacement gates
rules.reference_caveat: reference metadata is b5bf6d3 dirty; earlier host period, not a contemporaneous clean e1 run; observed regression does not establish cause
rules.raw_identity: historical SHA checked against existing comparison identities; final SHA computed on analysis then rechecked here; no claim of an external prior raw checksum chain
rules.logs: scan each captured raw diagnostic_logs server/worker text and the whole raw anew; log presence and worker exit codes checked
rules.minute_counts: all measured samples retained; partial final bucket displayed and excluded from trend fitting
